description: This file declares interfaces related to paging functionality within a software project, including functions to setup, wait for, and check if a pager is in use, as well as configurations related to terminal and pager settings.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Retrieves the pager command associated with the repository.

methods.name: setup_pager
methods.description: Initializes pager settings for the repository.

methods.name: wait_for_pager
methods.description: Waits for the pager process to complete.

methods.name: pager_in_use
methods.description: Checks if a pager is currently active.

methods.name: term_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the terminal.

methods.name: term_clear_line
methods.description: Clears the current line in the terminal.

methods.name: decimal_width
methods.description: Computes the width needed to display a decimal number.

methods.name: check_pager_config
methods.description: Verifies the pager configuration against the repository and command.

methods.name: prepare_pager_args
methods.description: Prepares argument list for pager command.
